method: Wilson 95% binomial; 1000 page-cluster resamples with replacement, seed 20261024. Within-book uncertainty, not independent books or baseline uncertainty.

per_page.cross_page_pair_policy: Attribute boundary pair to its second endpoint page; preserves every original pair and aggregate.
per_page.exact_match_interval: not estimated: frozen aggregate exposes no page-attributed exact logical-unit contribution; units can cross pages.

chained.cross_page_pair_policy: Attribute boundary pair to its second endpoint page; preserves every original pair and aggregate.
chained.exact_match_interval: not estimated: frozen aggregate exposes no page-attributed exact logical-unit contribution; units can cross pages.

tables.clusters_note: Matched reference-page clusters only; 10/11 detected segments. Joined-table interval not estimated: one multi-page table.

source_first_safety.deduplication: within family by physical page and sorted owning-unit IDs; merged source occurrences retained as child IDs. No pooling across families.
